method: Independent re-verification, not a read of the rewrite's self-reported reVerification blocks. I pulled the real ARES VR REST endpoint (https://ares.gov.cz/ekonomicke-subjekty-v-be/rest/ekonomicke-subjekty-vr/<ICO>) directly by curl for 15 IČO: 61463647 (Válková), 25488627 + 62240935 (Foldyna), 46347534 / 60193468 / 60713470 / 09133267 / 25508881 (Hladík), 27720004 (Hrnčíř), 26025027 (Bartošek), 03709698 / 03265889 / 03921727 (Decroix), 06386237 / 09187944 (Pařil), plus 48161063 (Výborný's Gymnázium) and the plain ekonomicke-subjekty record for the shared OSVČ placeholder 04627695. For each I parsed statutarniOrgany / ostatniOrgany / spolecnici down to the clenstvi.vznikClenstvi, clenstvi.zanikClenstvi, funkce.vznikFunkce, funkce.zanikFunkce, datumZapisu, datumVymazu, podíl/vklad and the fyzickaOsoba datumNarozeni + adresa fields, so every tie was entity-matched on birth date and address, not on name string. I then WebFetched three of the cited or.justice.cz úplné výpisy (subjektId 1084274 ARENA BRNO, 83968 Nadační fond Nemocnice Dačice, 665391 Družstvo Plavecká 12) to confirm the citation URLs resolve to the right subject and corroborate the ARES dates from the second, independent register mirror. Finally I re-read both payload files for headline↔notes consistency and tone calibration.
overallVerdict: PERSIST-WITH-EDITS. Every headline money claim in the rewrite is independently confirmed against primary register data — the batch-004 pass genuinely fixed the batch-003 false-negative epidemic, and its date accuracy is very high (Foldyna's Krajská zdravotní, Hrnčíř's surviving 100% ownership, Bartošek's Nadační fond chair, Decroix's own jednatel/společník roles, Pařil's RAPAJA/RMPJ split and four of Hladík's five company dates match the register exactly). Tone discipline is good: Foldyna is correctly kept MINOR/historical, Decroix's two newly-found roles are correctly framed as short and long-closed, and the material current ties (Válková, Hrnčíř, Bartošek, Pařil, Hladík) are stated with weight but without editorializing. Persist is nevertheless blocked pending edits because my own sweep found two residual false negatives of exactly the class this batch existed to eliminate: (1) Foldyna's dossier still says the Dopravní podnik města Děčína tie is unverified, while VR 62240935 shows him as its předseda představenstva 2011-01-04 → 2014-12-31 against a contractCzk of 1,000,000; and (2) Výborný's dossier — left untouched because the batch-003 Opus verdict graded his money side CORRECTLY_HEDGED — omits that VR 48161063 shows him as ředitel školy (statutory organ) of Gymnázium Pardubice 2012-08-01 → 2022-02-28, i.e. he was the statutory head of the single entity carrying his 9,253,982.84 CZK contract figure. That prior CORRECTLY_HEDGED grade was itself a plain-endpoint false negative. Three further items are cosmetic-to-minor but should be corrected in the same pass: a reversed date on Hladík's second Teplárny Brno term, a wrong successor-owner attribution on Decroix's ELEMENTA, and a start-date slip on Válková. Once those five edits land, this batch is persist-safe.

Helena Válková.issue: Substance fully confirmed: VR 61463647 shows JUDr. Helena Válková (b. 1951-01-07, Plavecká 400/12 — the co-op's own building) as předsedkyně představenstva in an unbroken chain of re-registrations, current record datumZapisu 2019-08-26 / vznikFunkce 2019-06-14 with no zanik, so the tie is live at verification date; contractCzk 0 and the OSVČ-placeholder hedge are both right. Minor date defect: the notes say the role runs 'od 23. 6. 2001' — both ARES VR and the cited or.justice.cz výpis give vznikFunkce 2001-10-23 (23. 6. 2004 is the END of the following term, apparently conflated).

Jaroslav Foldyna.issue: The Krajská zdravotní claim is exact and correctly hedged — VR 25488627 confirms Jaroslav Foldyna (b. 1960-06-26, Děčín) as Předseda představenstva vznikFunkce 2004-05-05 → zanikFunkce 2005-06-15, výmaz 2006-01-30, and keeping it framed MINOR/historical rather than as a headline is the right call. But the rewrite reproduces a batch-003 false negative on the second entity: it states the Dopravní podnik města Děčína tie 'zůstává neověřený', while VR 62240935 shows the same person (identical birth date, Děčín address) as Předseda představenstva, vznikClenstvi 2011-01-04 / vznikFunkce 2011-02-04 → zanikFunkce 2014-12-31 (výmaz 2015-03-26) — a documented personal statutory role at the entity carrying contractCzk 1,000,000. Only subjektId 27885 was actually cited/checked; DP Děčín was never looked up.

Petr Hladík.issue: The quintupled scope holds — I pulled all five companies myself and every one shows Mgr. PETR HLADÍK, b. 1984-09-28, Brno (náměstí SNP 1134/26 then Pod kaplí 288/33), a single unambiguous person, in a real personal statutory or supervisory role: ARENA BRNO (09133267) předseda dozorčí rady 2020-05-04 → 2022-10-31, výmaz 2023-02-07; DPMB (25508881) místopředseda dozorčí rady 2014-12-02 → 2015-10-31; MERO ČR (60193468) člen dozorčí rady 2015-08-12 → 2019-01-31 across overlapping corrective filings; SAKO Brno (60713470) člen dozorčí rady 2018-12-12 → 2021-11-16, výmaz 2021-12-22; Teplárny Brno (46347534) předseda představenstva vznikFunkce 2014-12-15 → zanikFunkce 2018-11-30. Four of the five date ranges match the rewrite to the day, and the batch-003 'institutional oversight through the city council, not a documented personal tie' hedge is demonstrably wrong. Two defects: (a) the Teplárny second term is stated backwards — the rewrite says he was 'opět členem představenstva DO 1. 11. 2022', but 2022-11-01 is vznikClenstvi; the second membership ran 2022-11-01 → 2023-01-11 (zápis 2023-01-03, výmaz 2023-02-09), i.e. ~2.5 months, not a term ending in 2022; (b) the headline says 've 4 z 5' companies while the notes document all five (ARENA, Teplárny, MERO, SAKO, DPMB) — internally inconsistent, and it understates rather than overstates. The ARENA framing ('role pokrývá klíčové období výstavby/zadávání') is an inference but a defensible one, since he chaired the supervisory board from the company's registration date onward.

Eva Decroix.issue: All three personal ties confirmed for Mgr. EVA DECROIX, b. 1982-05-26 (Praha 6 then Jihlava — matches the MP), and the framing of ELEMENTA/Park Volmanec as short, long-closed, zero-contract roles is properly calibrated. Delices de papa (03709698): jednatelka 2015-01-13 → zanikFunkce 2021-05-31 and společnice 50% → 100%, with Rémi Decroix as co-jednatel and now sole 100% owner from 2021-06 — exact. ELEMENTA (03265889): jednatelka + 100% společnice 2014-08-05 → zanikFunkce 2016-12-21 (výmaz 2017-01-27) — exact. Park Volmanec (03921727): jednatelka 2015-03-24 → 2015-10-20, společnice registered 2015-03-24 → 2015-09-24 — exact. Two defects: (a) the notes say ELEMENTA was later taken over by 'zahraniční vlastníci (Laurens Roering, Koepelinvest B.V.)' — that is false; ELEMENTA passed to Lucie Horáčková (CZ) and later Dejan Hrnjica / Eliška Běťáková. Laurens Kristiaan Roering and Koepelinvest B.V. are the Park Volmanec successors; the two companies' successor stories have been conflated. (b) Park Volmanec is described as a '50% společnice' role, but the register shows her holding two separate 50% podíly (2× 2,500 CZK) — i.e. the whole company — the same structure Koepelinvest inherited. Understates, does not overstate. Separately: the batch-003 NACE-94920 mislabel ('profesní organizace') has been correctly dropped, and the OSVČ 04627695 placeholder theory is well founded — the plain ARES record literally carries obchodniJmeno 'OSVČ', sídlo č.p. 323, 33016 Všeruby, NACE 94920 (political organizations), vznik 2015-12-09.

Patrik Pařil.issue: The RMPJ/RAPAJA distinction is exactly right and I verified it field-by-field. RAPAJA s.r.o. (06386237): Mgr. PATRIK PAŘIL, b. 1988-01-30, Znojemská 1115 Pohořelice, is a current jednatel AND a current společník — podíl 25%, vklad 50,000 CZK, record datumZapisu 2021-05-05 with no datumVymazu; Radovan Pařil (b. 1968-01-26) holds 75%; Jakub Pařil (b. 1990-12-04) held 25% and exited 2018-08-23, matching the rewrite. RMPJ s.r.o. (09187944): Patrik Pařil is a current jednatel (record 2021-05-05, no výmaz) but there is NO společník record in his name at all — the only společník entries are Radovan Pařil at 100% / 200,000 CZK, the live one registered 2021-05-05 with no výmaz. So the rewrite's nuance holds precisely: jednatel-only at RMPJ, jednatel + 25% owner at RAPAJA, and batch-003's 'ownership unconfirmable' hedge was wrong for RAPAJA while accidentally correct for RMPJ. One presentational nuance worth knowing but not blocking: the 2021-05-05 dates the rewrite quotes are address-change re-registrations, not the origin of the ties — the RAPAJA roles run continuously from 2017-08-29 and the RMPJ roles from 2020-05-25, so the notes understate tenure rather than inflate it (and the founding years are stated correctly elsewhere in the same text).

Marek Výborný.issue: The prose fix itself is correct and self-consistent — the '6 autorsky vedených tisků' figure is unsupported by bills_authored and the corrected 2 + 1 = 3 count matches the tisk IDs already in currentProps, so that part is fine. The material problem is what was deliberately left untouched. His dossier's sole linked company, Gymnázium, Pardubice, Mozartova 449 (IČO 48161063, contractCzk 9,253,982.84), was graded CORRECTLY_HEDGED by the batch-003 Opus verdict and therefore never re-verified through the VR endpoint. VR 48161063 shows MAREK VÝBORNÝ, b. 1976-07-10, Konopáčská 948, Heřmanův Městec — the MP — as ředitel školy, i.e. the school's statutory organ, vznikFunkce 2012-08-01 → zanikFunkce 2022-02-28 (zápis 2013-03-26, výmaz 2022-04-22). The dossier text ('jde o veřejnou střední školu v jeho volebním kraji — kontext smlouvy nebyl touto skupinou dohledáván') discloses none of this, so persisting it would ship a nearly decade-long statutory role at the entity carrying the money figure as an undisclosed, unflagged blank. This is the same plain-endpoint false negative that motivated the whole batch; the prior CORRECTLY_HEDGED grade was wrong, not the rewrite agent's scoping.
